'''Empideera Kkek''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] trader who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the height of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. He considered himself an "exalted master scavenger", and was one of the few Jawa's to give refunds for damaged or defective merchandise. This tactic angered his fellow clan members, until they discovered that it was an effective way to make money. Empideera's modified [[Power droid/Legends|power droid]], [[DC-GNK]], served as his translator in trading business.
